scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist'); fs.cpSync('public/build', 'dist/build', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('public/favicon.svg')) fs.copyFileSync('public/favicon.svg', 'dist/favicon.svg'); if (fs.existsSync('public/robots.txt')) fs.copyFileSync('public/robots.txt', 'dist/robots.txt');"
